ReSpliceCore.PsychicRitualDef_CreateVoid.label: dark archite harvesting
ReSpliceCore.PsychicRitualDef_CreateVoid.description: Attempt to extract one of the target's dark archite genes and bind it into a voidspike. The voidspike can then be infused into another person.\n\nThe target will be killed and their corpse destroyed even if the harvest fails.
ReSpliceCore.PsychicRitualDef_CreateVoid.outcomeDescription: The target will be killed and their corpse destroyed even if the harvest fails. A successful harvest produces one voidspike containing a randomly selected dark archite gene from the target.\n\nWith the current ritual quality, the chance of a successful harvest is {0}.
